newer_changes_search: Web search (2026-10-26): the restructured scheme (Cabinet Aug 2025; MoHUA guidelines Jan 2026, already cited) runs lending to 31 Mar 2030 with tranches of Rs 15,000 / 25,000 / 50,000 and a RuPay credit card after the 2nd tranche. Six-year milestone in June 2026. No later change found. MoHUA posted a further document in June 2026 that I did not read.

findings.note: The portal's content_hash has no snapshot file in content/snapshots/, and documents.aadhaar is cited to it, so that document is unchecked.
findings.suggestion: Write the portal snapshot, or cite the guidelines (or the operational guidelines) for documents.

findings.note: The source limits the scheme to vendors in 'city-regions' (statutory towns, census towns, peri-urban areas). A vendor in an ordinary village passes. A hard area rule would wrongly exclude census-town and peri-urban vendors who answer 'rural', so leaving it out is defensible.
findings.suggestion: Say clearly in the summary that village vendors outside census towns and peri-urban areas are not covered (the summary already lists the areas). Optionally add a soft note.

findings.note: 'a Common Service Centre or the PM SVANidhi portal' is not in the guideline snapshot, which names the PMS portal (Udyami Mitra) and says operational guidelines will be issued separately.
findings.suggestion: Cite the portal or the operational guidelines for the channels once they are snapshotted.
